# Hotpath documentation rules for scripts/check-pr-quality.sh.
#
# Format:
# hot_globs|doc_globs|reason
#
# Globs are Bash [[ string == pattern ]] patterns separated by spaces.
# In commit mode, a non-test commit that touches any hot_globs entry must also
# touch at least one matching doc_globs entry in the same commit.
# In PR diff mode, the same mapping is enforced against the aggregate pull
# request diff.
